name: FauxmoESP
description: fauxmoESP 3.4.1 (Amazon Alexa as a Belkin WeMo / Hue bridge) for ESPurna: LibreTiny (BK72xx) support (the ESP32 code paths with WiFi.h, the MD5 functions of the LibreTiny core instead of MD5Builder, the SSDP listener on a lwIP udp_pcb instead of WiFiUDP) and no TCP of its own: the application's web server hands the requests to process(isGet, url, body, reply), the answer comes back through the reply (no ESPAsyncTCP / AsyncTCP).
